title: What Shapes Brain Alignment of Large Language Models during Dialogue? Insights from Language Production and Comprehension
abstract: arXiv:2610.22961v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Brain alignment of large language models (LLMs) offers a way to investigate representational similarities between LLMs and the human brain during language processing. While previous studies have mainly focused on passive language comprehension, little is known about such alignment during dialogue, in which speakers engage in both language production and comprehension. In this study, using fMRI data collected during dialogue, we examine brain alignment during language production and comprehension across LLM layers and brain regions. We assess its association with the intrinsic dimension (ID) of LLM representations and the contributions of several interpretable linguistic and communicative features. Our results reveal distinct patterns of brain alignment between production and comprehension, as well as strong associations with ID in brain regions associated with each processing mode. translated_title: 什么塑造了大型语言模型在对话过程中与大脑的对齐？来自语言产生与理解的洞察
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）与大脑的对齐为研究大型语言模型与人类大脑在语言处理过程中的表征相似性提供了一种途径。以往的研究主要集中在被动的语言理解上，而对于对话过程中这种对齐的了解却很少，而在对话中，说话者会同时进行语言产生和语言理解。在本研究中，我们利用对话过程中收集的fMRI数据，考察了大型语言模型各层和各脑区在语言产生与理解过程中的大脑对齐情况。我们评估了这种对齐与大型语言模型表征内在维度的关联，以及若干可解释的语言学和交际特征的贡献。我们的结果揭示了语言产生与理解之间截然不同的大脑对齐模式，以及与每种处理模式相关脑区中内在维度的强关联。此外，我们还发现语言学特征……
tldr: 本研究利用对话中的fMRI数据揭示了大型语言模型在语言产生与语言理解两种模式下呈现截然不同的大脑对齐模式，且对齐程度与模型表征的内在维度以及可解释的语言和交际特征密切相关。
en_tdlr: Using fMRI data collected during dialogue, this study reveals distinct patterns of brain alignment between LLMs and the human brain during language production versus comprehension, strongly associated with the intrinsic dimension of LLM representations and interpretable linguistic and communicative features.
